title: Fynkel data asset
description: `<name>.data.json` (ADR-0027, `docs/documents.md` § Data assets): one instance of a game-declared data type — a Dart class annotated `@FynkelDataAsset`, Unity's ScriptableObject. The engine owns the kind; the type is named by a namespaced type id and its `data` is checked against `schemas/data/<type>.schema.json`, which `fynkel codegen` writes from the class. A field absent from `data` takes the class's default.

type.description: The data type's id, such as game.Weapon.

version.description: The version of the type the data was written for (`@FynkelDataAsset(version:)`).

data.description: The exposed fields' values, in the type's JSON form.
